summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Stationexus launcher PWA. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (CRUD, filtering, 404, audio upload/stream/delete, 12MB limit). Frontend: Home launcher, category tabs, poster navigation to /oeuvre/:id, LANCER reader modal open/close, PIN unlock (1234) success + wrong PIN error, theme switcher (sakura) with persistence via localStorage, admin badge shows 'Création', add-creation-btn appears, Create dialog (title + livres category) successfully creates and item appears in Livres category with home-edit/home-delete controls visible. All functional flows working.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext: isAdmin is stored only in React state (not persisted to localStorage/session). A hard reload of the page in admin mode reverts to Visitor. If persistence across reloads is desired, persist isAdmin flag or a session token in sessionStorage. Current spec ('PIN stored in localStorage — visitor mode is read-only') is ambiguous, but users may find the reset surprising.
Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers; migrate to lifespan handlers before FastAPI removes them.
server.py POST /creations returns 200 by default; convention would be 201 Created. Tests still pass but consider explicit status_code=201.
No auth on write endpoints — DELETE/PUT/POST are publicly callable. Since the spec says single-user + admin PIN only client-side, this is a documented limitation but worth noting.
test_credentials: Admin PIN: 1234 (localStorage key sx_pin, default from AppContext)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 13 creations on startup (5 livres, 3 films, 1 dojo, 4 avenir). One temporary TEST_UI_Create item was created during UI test and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows validated end-to-end. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (9 tests) can be re-used as regression. Note: isAdmin state resets on hard reload — use SPA navigation (click Retour/logo-home) rather than page.goto after unlocking when writing further Playwright tests.
